findings.title: Broken Object Level Authorization (BOLA / IDOR)
findings.description: The endpoint returns customer account records based on the user-supplied route parameter `{id}` without validating whether the caller owns or has explicit delegation for the requested object.
findings.evidence: GET /api/users/usr_9984 returned HTTP 200 with complete PII and identity claims when requested using Bearer token belonging to caller usr_1042.
findings.impact: Horizontal privilege escalation allowing authenticated attackers to enumerate and scrape entire user registries, exposing contact information, security questions, and corporate role mappings.
findings.recommendation: Enforce strict Zero-Trust object authorization at the controller or service layer. Verify `token.sub === req.params.id` or validate administrative delegation role prior to querying database.
findings.implementationGuide: Configure an API policy filter or middleware `validateResourceOwnership({ param: "id", allowRoles: ["sec_admin"] })` immediately prior to handler execution.
findings.validationSteps: Issue request using token A for entity B and verify HTTP 403 Forbidden is returned with audit event dispatched to SIEM.

findings.title: Excessive JWT Token Lifetime & Weak Algorithm Support
findings.description: Access tokens are minted with an expiration (`exp`) timestamp exceeding 72 hours, and the token verification routine permits the deprecated `HS256` symmetric signing mode alongside asymmetric keys.
findings.evidence: Decoded JWT header indicates `{"alg":"HS256"}` accepted; payload claims include `exp: 1774358400` (+259,200s window) with no cryptographic refresh rotation binding.
findings.impact: If a token is intercepted via logs, proxies, or client-side storage, an adversary retains persistent unrevoked API access for days without triggering re-authentication.
findings.recommendation: Enforce asymmetric RS256/ES256 or EdDSA signatures only. Constrain short-lived access tokens to 15 minutes max, coupled with strict single-use refresh token rotation.
findings.implementationGuide: Set `jwt.sign(payload, privateKey, { algorithm: "ES256", expiresIn: "15m" })`. Reject any token carrying `"alg": "none"` or `"alg": "HS256"` at API Gateway.
findings.validationSteps: Inspect token headers to confirm ES256 signature; submit expired or altered token and confirm HTTP 401 Unauthorized.

findings.title: Missing Rate Limiting on Payment Ingestion Endpoint
findings.description: The payment transaction processing endpoint does not enforce rate throttling or burst protection per client IP or authenticated organization ID.
findings.evidence: Automated scan baseline generated 120 consecutive payment authorization POST requests within a 3.2-second window without receiving HTTP 429 Too Many Requests.
findings.impact: Vulnerability to card-testing attacks (card cracking / BIN attacks), payment gateway denial of service, and rapid resource exhaustion incurring merchant transaction penalty fees.
findings.recommendation: Implement distributed token bucket or sliding-window rate limiting on all financial mutation routes (e.g. max 10 requests per minute per merchant key, 5 per IP).
findings.implementationGuide: Deploy Redis-backed rate limiter: `rateLimiter({ windowMs: 60 * 1000, max: 10, keyGenerator: (req) => req.user?.orgId || req.ip })`.
findings.validationSteps: Send 11 rapid requests in 10 seconds; verify 11th request returns 429 with `Retry-After` header and security event logged.

findings.title: Sensitive PII & Cardholder Data Exposure in Response
findings.description: Endpoint response model serializes unmasked cardholder billing addresses and unencrypted bank routing identifiers in cleartext JSON.
findings.evidence: Response payload contains fields `"full_billing_address"`, `"bank_routing_unmasked"`, and plaintext card expiration year without tokenized masking.
findings.impact: Severe non-compliance with PCI-DSS Requirement 3.3 and 3.4; unauthorized callers or compromised frontend caches expose sensitive consumer financial data.
findings.recommendation: Apply response data transfer object (DTO) filtering to mask or omit non-essential fields prior to serialization.
findings.implementationGuide: Filter outgoing models with strict schema projection: return only `last4`, `brand`, and `tokenized_id`. Strip raw banking details.
findings.validationSteps: Query endpoint and verify response payload contains only PCI-compliant masked fields and no raw routing numbers.

findings.title: Permissive Wildcard CORS Configuration on Internal API
findings.description: The server returns `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *` in conjunction with `Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true` on an endpoint handling internal messaging broadcasts.
findings.evidence: CORS preflight OPTIONS request returned header `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *` while accepting session cookies.
findings.impact: Malicious external websites visited by an authenticated developer can forge cross-origin requests to trigger arbitrary webhook dispatch alerts.
findings.recommendation: Restrict `Access-Control-Allow-Origin` to an explicitly defined whitelist of trusted corporate origins and reject wildcard asterisks with credentials.
findings.implementationGuide: Configure CORS middleware: `cors({ origin: ["https://console.internal.corp"], credentials: true })`.
findings.validationSteps: Send OPTIONS request with header `Origin: https://evil-site.com`; verify server responds without allow header or returns 403.

findings.title: Missing Mandatory Security Headers (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame)
findings.description: API responses do not include defense-in-depth headers such as Strict-Transport-Security, X-Content-Type-Options, or Content-Security-Policy.
findings.evidence: Response headers missing `Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains` and `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`.
findings.impact: Increases susceptibility to protocol downgrade attacks, MIME-type confusion exploitation, and clickjacking overlays.
findings.recommendation: Implement standard security headers via reverse proxy or Helmet middleware across all API routes.
findings.implementationGuide: Mount `helmet()` or configure ingress controller to inject HSTS (max-age=63072000), `nosniff`, and `deny` frame options.
findings.validationSteps: Perform curl check and verify all required headers are present on all status codes (2xx, 4xx, 5xx).

cisControls.title: Enforce Strong TLS (1.2+ / 1.3) & Forward Secrecy
cisControls.description: Ensure all external and internal API ingress gateways strictly reject TLS 1.0/1.1, SSLv3, and insecure cipher suites, mandating TLS 1.3 with Perfect Forward Secrecy (PFS).
cisControls.detectedConfig: TLS 1.2 and 1.3 enabled; legacy CBC ciphers disabled; PFS active.
cisControls.remediation: Maintain modern cipher configurations in ingress gateway or load balancer certificates.

cisControls.title: Strict Authentication for All Non-Public Endpoints
cisControls.description: All API routes must default to closed/deny unless explicitly tagged with an authorized public route annotation. Insecure default-open routes are strictly prohibited.
cisControls.expectedConfig: DefaultPolicy: Deny; AuthRequired: True on 100% of internal/restricted routes.
cisControls.detectedConfig: Endpoint /api/webhooks/broadcast on Notification API permits unauthenticated POST.
cisControls.remediation: Apply Zero-Trust gateway interceptor requiring valid JWT or mTLS identity before routing to backend.

cisControls.title: JSON Web Token Expiration and Signature Validation
cisControls.description: Tokens must be signed with robust cryptographic algorithms (RS256/ES256), have a maximum lifespan of 15 minutes, and be validated against issuer, audience, and revocation registries.
cisControls.expectedConfig: MaxTokenLifetime: <= 15m; SupportedAlgs: ES256, RS256; RevocationCheck: Enabled.
cisControls.detectedConfig: Auth API issues 72h tokens; HS256 symmetric signature mode is permitted.
cisControls.remediation: Configure OAuth token service to cap access token expiration at 900 seconds and enforce ES256.

cisControls.title: Implement Role-Based Access Control and Principle of Least Privilege
cisControls.description: API controllers must verify caller roles and granular resource scopes. Administrative endpoints must enforce separation of duties.
cisControls.expectedConfig: RBAC: Enabled; Granular scopes enforced per route; DefaultLeastPrivilege: True.
cisControls.detectedConfig: User Management API allows caller to query other user objects (BOLA detected).
cisControls.remediation: Introduce resource ownership checks and granular permission claim verification in API handlers.

cisControls.title: Administrative Endpoint Isolation & Multi-Factor Verification
cisControls.description: Endpoints capable of altering security policies or user roles must require elevated authorization context and step-up MFA challenge.
cisControls.expectedConfig: AdminRoutes: Subnet-isolated or requires MFA claim `amr: ["mfa"]`.
cisControls.detectedConfig: Admin role assignment endpoint `/roles` requires Admin JWT, but lacks step-up MFA claim check.
cisControls.remediation: Inject step-up auth policy requirement for privileged administrative mutations.

cisControls.title: Cryptographic Protection for Sensitive Data in Transit & Rest
cisControls.description: All sensitive payloads, API credentials, and database fields containing financial or personal data must utilize AES-256-GCM or equivalent authenticated encryption.
cisControls.expectedConfig: DataInTransit: TLS 1.3; StorageEncryption: AES-256-GCM; KeyRotation: 90 days.
cisControls.detectedConfig: Database volume encryption enabled; transit TLS verified.
cisControls.remediation: Continue automated cryptographic key rotation every 90 days via KMS.

cisControls.title: Masking & Filtering of PII and Secrets in API Responses
cisControls.description: API responses must omit unnecessary fields and mask sensitive personal or financial indicators before returning to caller.
cisControls.expectedConfig: ResponseFiltering: Enabled; PII_Masking: Enforced on cards and identity numbers.
cisControls.detectedConfig: Payment Gateway API exposes unmasked billing address and routing identifiers.
cisControls.remediation: Apply projection filtering and mask credit card accounts to last 4 digits.

cisControls.title: Request Throttling & Rate Limiting per Client ID / IP
cisControls.description: Enforce rate limiting on all ingress endpoints to prevent brute-force attacks, credential stuffing, card cracking, and denial of service.
cisControls.expectedConfig: RateLimiting: Enabled globally; Tiered limits per auth status; BurstProtection: True.
cisControls.detectedConfig: Missing rate limiting on Payment Gateway `/charges` endpoint.
cisControls.remediation: Implement token bucket rate limiter at API gateway enforcing 10 req/min for charge endpoints.

cisControls.title: Strict Content-Type and Payload Validation to Prevent Injection
cisControls.description: Reject unexpected MIME types, enforce JSON schema validation on all incoming request bodies, and strip unknown parameters to prevent mass assignment.
cisControls.expectedConfig: SchemaValidation: Strict; DisallowUnknownFields: True; ContentType: Explicit.
cisControls.detectedConfig: JSON schema validation active on 4 out of 5 registered APIs.
cisControls.remediation: Ensure OpenAPI schema validation filters are mounted on all development services.

cisControls.title: Immutable Centralized Audit Logging with Cryptographic Integrity
cisControls.description: All security-relevant actions, authentication attempts, and authorization failures must be recorded in an immutable ledger with SHA-256 chain verification.
cisControls.expectedConfig: AuditLogging: Centralized; TamperEvident: SHA-256 Chained; Retention: >= 365 days.
cisControls.detectedConfig: ZENTRA SHA-256 tamper-evident cryptographic log chaining active with 100% hash verification.
cisControls.remediation: Verify continuous forward-link integrity and periodically archive immutable block snapshots.

cisControls.title: Automated Anomaly Detection & Security Alerting
cisControls.description: Near-real-time correlation of authentication spikes, authorization failures, and token anomaly events dispatched to security operations.
cisControls.detectedConfig: Real-time telemetry event stream operational with automated threshold notifications.
cisControls.remediation: Tune alert thresholds quarterly based on traffic baseline growth.
